tools.name: search_passports
tools.description: Search AI MAXX published company, service and place records by a specific customer need or business name. Returns source links, review dates, arrival information and availability caveats. This catalogue is limited to its listed businesses; it does not search the whole web or guarantee availability.

tools.name: get_passport
tools.description: Read one public AI MAXX passport using an exact id returned by search_passports. Returns published facts and provenance. Does not access customer accounts, enquiries, private drafts or payment records.

tools.name: catalogue_coverage
tools.description: Read the actual countries, companies and record counts currently included in the public AI MAXX catalogue. Useful for checking whether the requested geography is covered before searching.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_passports · Private data: search_passports, get_passport, catalogue_coverage, resolve_customer_need, consult_events, consult_activities, consult_hospitality, consult_venues · Public sink: resolve_customer_need, consult_events, consult_activities, consult_hospitality, consult_venues.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_passports · Private data: search_passports, get_passport, catalogue_coverage, resolve_customer_need, consult_events, consult_activities, consult_hospitality, consult_venues · Public sink: resolve_customer_need, consult_events, consult_activities, consult_hospitality, consult_venues

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
